SimulatorInterruptTemplate.interruption_bias_frequent: Interrupt aggressively on verbosity, slow pacing, digressions, or any chance to cut ahead with the user's next point. Still skip interruptions that would be nonsense mid-word.
SimulatorInterruptTemplate.interruption_bias_normal: Interrupt when a real phone caller would naturally clarify, redirect, answer early, or cut off an obvious digression. Do not interrupt routine helpful speech.
SimulatorInterruptTemplate.interruption_bias_rare: Only interrupt when the agent clearly errs, contradicts itself, asks something the user already answered, or is stuck. Prefer waiting through the full reply in almost all other cases.
SimulatorInterruptTemplate.interruption_frustration: FRUSTRATION: The user already tried to speak and the agent talked over them. If you interrupt, sound briefly impatient or curt — still stay in character and on-scenario.
